description: On-device Apple Watch edge trajectory contract. Fixed 100 Hz IMU input; outputs phases, 64-point XYZ trajectory, confidence, and transition_rush. NumPy teacher/student and Core ML package share this contract.

input.layout: time-major (T, 6), zero-padded/truncated to max_samples for the student feature path

trajectory_xyz.frame: address-relative wrist path, uniformly sampled address→finish

transition_rush.note: Early-release / casting rush proxy (1 = more rushed transition)

artifact.coreml: edge_trajectory_v1.mlpackage; specification version 7, input features[1,29], output edge_outputs[1,198].

runtime: Watch blends the student as a bounded correction to causal kinematic preview; iPhone/Mac Python remains final authority.
